activity.notes: Government of India cultural documentation places Tansen's entry into Akbar's court around 1563 and preserves 1588 as a conventional death date, while biographical chronology varies across later traditions. ATLAS therefore records the Mughal court-musician phase with approximate boundaries and excludes miracle stories and other legendary accretions.

sources.title: Tansen and his musical legacy — Government of India cultural documentation
sources.citation_text: Government of India cultural documentation identifies Tansen as a celebrated musician of Akbar's court, places his summons to the Mughal court around 1563, and preserves the conventional late-sixteenth-century chronology.
